item.title: Union Berlin, Schalke and Hannover 96 linked with out-of-favour Leeds midfielder

item.title: Germany not among the "top favourites" to win the World Cup, claims Kimmich
item.description: After two consecutive World Cup group-stage exits, Joshua Kimmich doesn't believe Germany are among the top favourites to win this summer's tournament in the United States, Mexico and Canada.
